allOf.$comment: Canonical runtime additionally checks monitor deployment_id != origin_deployment_id and last_observation_ms >= effective_at_ms. Ordinary JSON Schema has no arbitrary sibling-value comparison. Current source/target authority and pure-projector prerequisites are not installed by this structural schema.
Canonical runtime additionally requires window.from_ms < window.to_ms when window is not null. ALL does not force environment=null. Navigation is not an authorization grant.
